Crowns & Prosthetics

Crowns & Prosthetics

A badly damaged or missing tooth can be restored with a crown or prosthesis, bringing back both function and natural appearance.

Ask on WhatsApp

About the treatment

Intraoral scanning helps produce a highly precise crown that integrates cleanly with your bite and neighboring teeth.

Who it's for

  • —A tooth is significantly damaged or weakened
  • —One or more teeth are missing
  • —You want a durable, natural-looking solution

Benefits

Precise digital measurement

Natural look and a comfortable bite

Durable materials

An individual approach for every case

How we work

01

Consultation

We listen to your goals and concerns, review your overall oral health, and answer every question before anything else happens.

02

Digital diagnostics

Where relevant, we use 3D CBCT imaging and intraoral scanning to see the full picture with precision, not guesswork.

03

Personal treatment plan

Based on the diagnostics, we build a clear, staged treatment plan and walk you through what each step is for.

04

Treatment

We carry out the treatment according to plan, using modern technology and paying close attention to your comfort throughout.

05

Follow-up

We monitor how you're healing, schedule check-ins, and stay reachable if anything comes up afterward.

Technology used

Intraoral Scanning

A precise digital model of your teeth, without traditional impression material.

Digital Treatment Planning

Bringing all diagnostic data together into one clear, staged plan.
